subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 147 (UPB(II)-9). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TR-INFO (trans-information) and TRS (transition). From TR-INFO: SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). From TRS: ALT-C-PROG, CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From CULT-SOLD: AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: PART (participation). From MT-INFO: ATTN (attraction). The page text speaks of the actualness of "affinity alignment".
